name: PVC Hip Hinge
how_to:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
2. Hold a PVC pipe vertically along your spine, using one hand behind your neck and the other behind your lower back.
3. Ensure three contact points: the back of the head, between the shoulder blades, and the tailbone.
4. Begin the hinge by pushing your hips back, keeping your spine straight and the PVC in contact with all three points.
5. Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then return to the starting position by driving your hips forward.
